reason: I've never tried magnesium and £24.99 for a jar of gummies is a lot when Boots magnesium is about £5. The sugar and glucose syrup in a supplement also put me off, though I'd join the waitlist to see the price at launch.
objection: Why would I pay five times the price of a supermarket or Boots magnesium for something that is mostly sugar, when I haven't got any proof it works better?
would_change_my_mind: A launch price much closer to the Boots price, or proof that this form of magnesium works better than the cheap tablets I can already buy.
